summary: A Bathurst Street dental clinic appears to lose new patients to a builder footer, a hotmail contact and a booking form with no clear next step.

findings.problem: The footer appears to say Proudly created with Wix.com, with no clinic name or year.
findings.cost: A builder credit and no clinic name make a new patient see a template instead of a trusted practice.
findings.fix: A footer with your clinic name and a clean finish.

findings.problem: The contact appears to be a hotmail address, a phone number and a fax number.
findings.cost: A free hotmail address gives less trust for implants and veneers, and a fax number looks dated to a younger patient.
findings.fix: A professional email on your own domain.

findings.problem: The appointment form appears to offer every hour of the day, from 12:00 AM to 11:00 PM, plus a stray 02:30 PM option.
findings.cost: A patient picking a time at midnight gets a confusing form, and a confusing form means fewer booked visits.
findings.fix: A booking form that shows only your open hours.

findings.problem: No text or WhatsApp option appears on the page.
findings.cost: Patients who want a quick answer have only a phone call, and many will not wait for a call back.
findings.fix: A one tap text button next to the form.

redesign: Booking form with real hours and a text button.
